http_uri
Description
Specifies a URL, but does not include the protocol and the fully
qualified domain name (FQDN). For example, if the URL is
http://www.mysite.com/buy.asp
, then the URI is
/buy.asp
. This
command is a BIG-IP 4.X variable, provided for backward-compatibility.
You can use the equivalent 9.x command
HTTP::uri
instead.
Syntax
http_uri
http_uri
Specifies a URI, which is a URL that does not include the protocol
and the fully qualified domain name (FQDN).
